verification_rules: contract is a live I04 verifier-registered witness at point of use
effect destination equals verified contract destination
effect adapter profile equals verified contract adapter profile
receipt effect ID and payload root equal the committed effect
delivery state contains the exact canonical destination record
destination receipt root equals the I04-derived receipt root
verifier profile equals the declared destination-ack verifier profile
subject root is recomputed from every ack subject field
rejection_witnesses: exact-class contract without I04 verifier provenance
nonclaims: no lost-ack recovery or runtime mounting
